fields.System.Title: OUT-407 — Batch picking across orders
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want to collect items for several orders in one trip, so that one walk
of the aisle serves twenty orders instead of one.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a wave, then pick lines across orders for the same location are combined into
  • one visit with a total quantity.
  • - Given a combined pick, then the picker is told which cart compartment each order's
  • units go into.
  • - Given a compartment scan, then placing units into the wrong compartment is rejected.
  • - Given a short pick on a combined line, then the shortfall is attributed to specific
  • orders by priority, not spread arbitrarily.
  • - Given the batch, then each order's consumption is recorded separately in the ledger.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | pick_task, pick_task_line, reservation |
| Risks | Sortation errors causing wrong-item shipments ([doc 07 §7](../../../docs/07-phased-delivery-plan.md)); ambiguous shortfall attribution |
| Tests | unit · integration · invariant |
